stores.name: MongoDB (revex-blade-platform)
stores.purpose: System of record for wallets and wallet money moves: companywallettransactions, locationwallettransactions, companywallets, locationwallets, charge (chargeV4/V5), wallet_taxes, recharge failure logs. Wallet-transaction collections are TTL-archived (hard delete) after 95 days, so Mongo holds only the recent window.

stores.name: GCP Pub/Sub
stores.purpose: Transport for every pipeline: platform-backend change-stream fan-out (globalEvents.ts), blade data-warehouse topics, analytics worker, wallet-ledger events, TigerBeetle CDC republish.

stores.name: RabbitMQ (tigerbeetle vhost)
stores.purpose: Receives TigerBeetle native CDC (AMQP) on queue tigerbeetle.events; bridged to Pub/Sub by tigerbeetle-rmq-to-pubsub-worker.

stores.name: TigerBeetle ledger
stores.purpose: Double-entry ledger (wallet ledger + GL ledger 2026014). Written by revex-ledger-worker from revex-blade-wallet-ledger-events. Source for tb_ledger in ClickHouse via CDC.

stores.name: GCS data lake (automation-bi-data-lake-production)
stores.purpose: Data-team owned landing zone. NDJSON CDC rows {model, after, before, event_type} from automation-bi-snowflake-global-events. Read by Snowflake (automation_bi.snowflake role) and by ClickHouse Cloud (automation-bi-ch-stor-read SA); used as source for CWT v2 GCS backfills.

stores.name: ClickHouse Cloud (revex-blade-data-analytics, db hl_transaction_analytics)
stores.purpose: Wallet analytics warehouse: raw wallet-transaction copies (v1 and v2), hourly refreshable rollups for usage/spending APIs, daily reconciliations, tb_ledger CDC copy and GL recon views. Env CLICKHOUSE_REVEX_BLADE_DATA_WAREHOUSE_*.

stores.name: Snowflake (PROD_HIGHLEVEL_DWH)
stores.purpose: Company-wide BI warehouse owned by data/automation-bi team. Wallet data lands as MONGODB_LC.* tables (COMPANY_WALLET_TRANSACTIONS, LOCATION_WALLET_TRANSACTIONS) and via the data-team CDC pipeline; planned Finance target for GL ledger export.

stores.name: Redis / Memorystore (blade-platform)
stores.purpose: Wallet recharge/balance cache (synced by recharge worker), wallet-spending ClickHouse query-result cache, product-bucket and tax-code caches. Not a pipeline sink for history.

stores.name: Elasticsearch (saas-service-* daily indices)
stores.purpose: Transaction ops logging (transaction-events namespace) via analytics worker ES_EVENT; locations-elasticsearch-locationwallet-events for location wallets. wallet-events-tracker plan to re-enable ES logging is superseded.

stores.name: Prometheus (Grafana datasource)
stores.purpose: Wallet money-flow counters/histograms (charges_total, wallet_recharge_total, charge_settle_duration_seconds, wallet_negative_balance_total, ledger_recon_*) emitted by blade workers; backs Blade Wallet Metrics v2 dashboard.

stores.name: BigQuery
stores.purpose: Not used by any wallet/billing path found. No BigQuery client or sink in apps/blade-platform, apps/ledger, saas-service or the globalEvents wallet routes.

COMPANY_WALLETS / LOCATION_WALLETS -> automation-bi-snowflake-global-events, revex-blade-wallet-recharge-events (currentBalance/complimentaryCredits/status); location wallets also -> locations-elasticsearch-locationwallet-events

Consumer code is not in any workspace repo.
objects: companywallettransactions, locationwallettransactions, companywallets, locationwallets, wallet_taxes, recharge failure / refund settlement logs -> GCS automation-bi-data-lake-production (NDJSON {model, after, before, event_type}) -> Snowflake

pipelines.mechanism: blade transaction worker publishes ES_EVENT / TRANSACTION_SETTLEMENT_EVENT / WALLET_METRIC_EVENT to analytics worker; worker writes ES (saveElasticLoggingEvent, index saas-service-<date>) and increments Prometheus counters
objects: transaction-updated ops payload -> ES saas-service-* index

k8s CronJob POST /blade-platform/cron/archive-data-by-ttl -> data-archival worker deletes docs older than 95 days (copyToGCS=false). History beyond 95 days survives only in ClickHouse / Snowflake / GCS data lake.

snowflake.summary: Two paths. (1) Main path, data-team owned: platform-backend change streams route companywallettransactions/locationwallettransactions (settled rows only), companywallets, locationwallets, wallet_taxes, refund-settlement and recharge-failure logs, plus TigerBeetle CDC (TIGERBEETLE_LEDGER_EVENT) to Pub/Sub topic automation-bi-snowflake-global-events. Data-team subscribers (automation-bi-snowflake-global*, data-engineering-snowflake-global) land NDJSON CDC rows in GCS automation-bi-data-lake-production, which Snowflake reads (automation_bi.snowflake IAM role). The loader/dbt code (automation-data-bi-platform) is not in the workspace, so the exact Snowflake table names and refresh cadence for this path are not visible. (2) A Revex-owned blade Snowflake adapter (PROD_HIGHLEVEL_DWH.MONGODB_LC.*_WALLET_TRANSACTIONS) exists in code, but nothing triggers it in production, so it is not part of the production data path. No Fivetran, Airbyte, Debezium, Datastream or BigQuery path found. Planned: dev-ledger GHLPRD-25474 Finance export of GL transfers/COA/daily balances to Snowflake (not started). The data team's Stripe Data Pipeline in Snowflake (STRIPE_DATA_PIPELINE.STRIPE) exists but stripe-wallet-reconciliation chose not to use it.
